formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : (Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) → Bool := fun (x1 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool) => [(1 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ), (23 : ℕ), (34 : ℕ), (40 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (16 : ℕ), (27 : ℕ), (38 : ℕ), (57 : ℕ), (68 : ℕ), (85 : ℕ)].any fun (x2 : ℕ) => x1 (Fin.ofNat (9 : ℕ) (x2 / (10 : ℕ))) && x1 (Fin.ofNat (9 : ℕ) (x2 % (10 : ℕ))); ¬PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize (9 : ℕ) x1 (14 : ℕ))
plain_statement: It is false that: The edge function F of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges, written as a list of two-digit codes ab for the edge a b) has no circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates with at most 14 gates.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate OR(x_0, x_4) computes
